spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पोटति)
To rub, to press, to grind or pound.
r. 6th cl. (पुटति)
To embrace, to intertwine.
r. 10th cl. (पोटयति)
1 To be or become small, or shallow.
2 To shine.
3 To speak.
4 To reduce to powder, to grind.
(पुटयति)
To fasten, to string, to bind together.

mfn. (-टः-टी-टं)
1 A cover, a covering.
2 A plate or vessel, made of leaves.
3 A cloth worn to cover the privities.
4 An eyelid.
5 A cup or concavity, made of a leaf folded or doubled.
6 A concavity, a shallow cup or receptacle, as the hollow of the hand.
m. (-टः)
A horse's hoof.
2 A narrowing or contracting of any thing.
3 A folding or doubling of any thing, so as to form a cup or concavity.
n. (-टं)
Two vessels [] joined together, the upper one inverted for the sublimation or digestion of medicaments.
E.
पुट to rub or bind, aff. क.

r. 10th cl. (पुट्टयति)
To decrease, to diminish, to be or become small, low or shallow.

n. (-कं)
1 A lotus.
2 A bag or vessel made of a leaf doubled over in a funnel-like shape.
3 Any shallow cup or concavity.
E.
पुट to unite, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-नी)
An assemblage of lotus flowers.
E.
पुटक, and इनि aff.

m. (-वः)
1 A pot, a jar, a pitcher.
2 A brass jug.
E.
पुट a contracting, from पुट, and ग्रीवा the neck; having a narrow neck.

m. (-कः)
Digesting, subliming.
E.
पुट, and पाक cooking.

m. (-दः)
1 The bend of a river.
2 A city, a town.
3 A musical instrument.
E.
पुट a contraction, and भेद breaking.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sewn, stitched.
2 Rubbed, ground.
3 Contracted.
n. (-तं)
Closing or shutting the hands, to hold any thing, the hollow of the hand.
E.
पुट rubbing, &c. and इतच् aff.

n. (-जं)
A white umbrella or parasol.
E.
पुट a covering, and उटज a house.

m. (-कः)
The cocoanut.
E.
पुट a covering, and उरक water.
